description: Source code for NetworkManagerStunClient, implementing STUN protocol client functionalities including message encoding/decoding, socket communication, and network address handling.

classes.name: file_descriptor
classes.description: Manages a file descriptor, ensuring it is closed upon destruction.

classes.name: message
classes.description: Represents a STUN message with encoding and attribute management.

classes.name: message_factory
classes.description: Creates different types of STUN messages, such as binding requests.

classes.name: client
classes.description: Implements STUN client functionalities including binding, message sending, and network discovery.

classes.name: attributes::address
classes.description: Represents a network address attribute decoded from a STUN message.

methods.name: create_binding_request
methods.description: Creates a STUN binding request message with a random transaction ID.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Performs a binding request to discover public IP and port, with caching support.

methods.name: create_udp_socket
methods.description: Creates and binds a UDP socket, optionally to a specific local interface.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends a STUN message over UDP and waits for a response.

methods.name: discover_network_access_type
methods.description: Determines the network access type (e.g., UDP blocked, unknown) by performing STUN binding requests.

methods.name: send_binding_request
methods.description: Sends a binding request to the server, with retries and wait times.

methods.name: send_binding_request (overloaded)
methods.description: Sends a binding request to a specific address.
